mapper.select: SELECT category_id, name, description FROM m_category ORDER BY category_id

SELECT i.item_id AS item_id, i.product_id AS product_id, i.attribute1 AS attribute1, i.list_price AS list_price, COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) AS quantity FROM m_item i LEFT JOIN t_inventory inv ON inv.item_id = i.item_id WHERE i.product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY i.item_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT i.item_id AS item_id, i.product_id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.description AS product_description, i.attribute1 AS attribute1, i.list_price AS list_price, COALESCE(inv.quantity, 0) AS quantity FROM m_item i JOIN m_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN t_inventory inv ON inv.item_id = i.item_id WHERE i.item_id = #{itemId}
